# Biofuel Ash Aging in Acidic Environment and Its Influence on Cd Immobilization

**Авторы:** Song Le, Zhao Feng, Cui Haiyang, Wan Jingmin, Li Hui

**Журнал:** International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health (2023)

**DOI:** 10.3390/ijerph20054635


## Abstract
source_units.reason: article_metadata_header

source_units.text: Biofuel ash (BFA), which is the ash generated by biomass combustion in a biomass power plant, can be prepared as a heavy metal immobilizer and have a good immobilization effect on Cd in the soil environment of southern China, but the long-term effects of BFA on Cd immobilization remained unclear.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, research about BFA aging and its influence on Cd immobilization was conducted in the paper.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: BFA was naturally aged into BFA-Natural aging (BFA-N) in the soil environment of southern China, and to simulate BFA-N, BFA was also artificially acid aged into BFA-Acid aging (BFA-A).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The result indicated that BFA-A could partially simulate BFA-N in physicochemical properties.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The Cd adsorption capacity of BFA reduced after natural aging and the decrease was more obvious in BFA-A according to Qm in Langmuir equation and qe from the pseudo-second-order kinetic model.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The adsorption processes of BFA before and after aging were mainly controlled by chemical action rather than physical transport.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The immobilization of Cd included adsorption and precipitation, and adsorption was the dominant factor; the precipitation proportion was only 12.3%, 18.8%, and 1.7% of BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A, respectively.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Compared with BFA, both BFA-N and BFA-A showed Ca loss, and BFA-A was more obvious than BFA-N.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Ca content level was consistent with Cd adsorption level among BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A. It could be inferred that the main immobilization mechanism of Cd by BFA before and after aging was consistent and closely related to Ca.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, the adsorption mechanism of electrostatic interaction, ion exchange, and hydroxyl complexation changed to varying degrees in BFA-N and BFA-A.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text:
Introduction

Excessive heavy metal content exists in the southern farmland of China [1], in terms of soil pollution risk screening values of farming land [2].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: For example, there is excessive Cd in part of the farmland in Yangtze river basin [3] and Pearl river basin [4].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, from the perspective of the world, the Cd content of Chinese farmland is not too high on the whole, lower than that in European countries and America [5,6].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The accumulation of Cd in agricultural products is related to the total amount of Cd in soil, but also depends on the activity of Cd.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: For example, the total Cd content of soil in the UK is relatively high, but the Cd content of agricultural products rarely exceeds the standard; only 0.2% of wheat grain has a Cd content exceeding 0.2 mg/kg (Codex Alimentarius Commission Cd limit standard for wheat) [7].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In contrast, in the above major rice producing areas in the south of China [8], the exceeding standard rate of Cd in rice is high [9], and in some areas, the rate is as high as 60–70% [10,11], posing a threat to human health [12].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: To ensure food safety [13], much research has been carried out on the immobilization of heavy metals in farmland soil [14,15].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Biofuel ash (BFA) is the ash generated by biomass combustion in a biomass power plant [16].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: After the investigation and survey of multiple biomass power plants in southern China, what was found was that the heavy metal in BFA was volatile and enriched in the fly ash in the process of boiler combustion, and the heavy metal content in the bottom ash was less than 10% of the fly ash [17].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: After screening, the bottom ash was prepared as a heavy metal immobilizer [18], and the adsorption capacity of Cd could reach more than 16 mg/g [19].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The content of available Cd in soil was significantly reduced by adding BFA of 1% soil dry weight in an in situ remediation experiment that was carried out in the farmland with severe Cd pollution in south China, and the Cd in rice was reduced by more than 70% [20].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The climate in south China is hot and humid, with a high vegetation coverage rate, strong decomposition of organic matter, and high leaching degree of topsoil [21].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Precipitation presents weak acidity due to the dissolution of CO2 in the air and the formation of carbonic acid [22,23].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The soil is affected by the long-term effects of geochemistry, ecological environment, and climate conditions, and the content of substitutable hydrogen and aluminum is high, so it tends to be acidic [24,25].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addition to the above natural factors, NOX and SO2 emitted by human activities dissolve in rainwater forming acid rain which falls into the soil and introduces certain NO3− and SO42− [26,27], which makes the soil pH low and intensifies soil acidification degree [28,29].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The physical and chemical properties of BFA will be changed when it is applied in acidic soil in south China, that is, the aging of BFA may cause the release of minerals and affect the effect and mechanism of Cd immobilization [30].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The natural aging process is slow and time-consuming to monitor [31].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Artificial accelerated aging methods that simulate natural aging can significantly shorten the observation time, reducing the aging duration from years or months to days or hours [32].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In order to well simulate the process of acid aging, nitric acid (HNO3) and sulfuric acid (H2SO4) are usually selected to simulate acid rain [33].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Although BFA has achieved good results in the remediation of Cd-contaminated farmland in southern China, the aging of BFA and its long-term effects on Cd immobilization are still unclear.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In this paper, BFA aging in an acidic soil environment in southern China will be studied to explore the change of physicochemical properties of BFA, and then to reveal the influence on the effect and mechanism of Cd immobilization.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The artificial aging method is used to simulate natural aging of BFA in an acidic soil environment and its simulation effect is evaluated.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The research will lay the foundation for the long-term application of BFA in acidic soil of southern China.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

## 2. Materials and Methods

### 2.1.

source_units.text: Materials Selection
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Soil for the experiment was collected from the farmland of Daye City, Hubei Province, and the 0–20 cm topsoil was collected. The soil pH was 5.9. The heavy metal content of the soil was tested by the soil heavy metal analyzer Cadence (American XOS), and it did not exceed the screening value of soil pollution risk in agricultural land, meaning the pollution risk generally could be ignored in agricultural land environmental management of China [2].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The soil was ground through a 125 μm (120 mesh) sieve after air drying and set aside.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: BFA was obtained from the Jinzhou biomass power plant, Hebei Province, grinding and screening were in the size range of 250–500 μm (35–60 mesh) and 150 μm (100 mesh) particles.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

### 2.2. Aging Methods

#### 2.2.1. Natural Aging
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Ninety
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: grams of BFA with a particle size of 250–500 μm (35–60 mesh) was added to 300 g soil, fully mixed in the culture box, and three groups were set in parallel.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Natural aging was undertaken for 4 months and the mixture was placed in a 150 μm (100 mesh) screen.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: After ultrasonic cleaning, the surface of the screen was the aged BFA, which was then ground through a 150 μm (100 mesh) screen, and BFA-Natural aging (BFA-N) was obtained by freeze-drying.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The pH of BFA-N was 7.8.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text:
#### 2.2.2. Artificial Acid Aging

We diluted 70.54 mL of 98% concentrated sulfuric acid to 1000 mL with water to prepare 20% sulfuric acid. Then, 343.08 mL of 65% nitric acid was diluted to 1000 mL with water and prepared as 20% nitric acid.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Then, 300 mL of 20% sulfuric acid and 100 mL of 20% nitric acid were added to the beaker and mixed.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Finally, 5 g BFA, through 150 μm (100 mesh) particles, was added to the mixed acid solution; after 6 h of aging, the BFA-Acid aging (BFA-A) was obtained by freeze-drying [34,35].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The pH of BFA-A was 2.5.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

X-ray fluorescence spectrograph Axios (Netherlands PANa-lytical, Almelo, The Netherlands), X-ray diffractometer D8-ADVANCE (German Brucker), Fourier transform infrared IS10 (American Nicolet), Surface Area Instrument NOVA 4000e (American Quantachrome), ZETA potentiometer Nano ZS (British Malwen Instruments), and Field emission scanning electron microscope SU8202 (Japanese Hitachi) were used to determine the physical and chemical properties of BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A.

# 2.4. Adsorption Kinetic Experiment

BFAs (BFA, BFA-N, BFA-A) of 100 mg before and after aging were weighed, respectively, and placed in 50 mL centrifuge tubes; each group set up three repeats.

source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: After centrifugation and filtration, Cd2+ concentration of the supernatant was measured by ICP Avio500 (American PerkinElmer, Waltham, MA, USA).

Precipitation Experiment

Forty milliliters of Cd2+ solution with concentration of 40 mg/L (C0) was prepared using 200 mg/L Cd2+ reserve solution and 0.01 mol/L Ca2+ background solution in centrifuge tubes.

#### 3.1.2. Functional Group Change by FTIR

As shown in Figure 2, 3440 cm−1 was the stretching vibration peak of the hydroxyl group, and 1630 was the bending vibration peak of water. The peaks of BFA-A at both the above places were enhanced, indicating that the surface hydroxyl group was strengthened, while the peaks of BFA-N at both were weakened, indicating that the surface hydroxyl group was weakened. The antisymmetric vibration peak of O-C-O in CO32− was at 1430 cm−1, 875 cm−1 belonged to the out-of-plane bending vibration peak of O-C-O [37], the CO32− in BFA before aging was destroyed in BFA-A and BFA-N after aging in acidic conditions, and BFA-A was more obvious.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The peak at 1030 cm−1 was related to the asymmetric stretching vibration of Si-O-T (T = Si or Al) of the tetrahedron inside the aluminosilicate [38].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: BFA-A and BFA-N were enhanced here, and BFA-N was more obvious, BFA-A tended to move to a higher wave-number position, which is due to the fact that Si-O was shorter and stronger than Al-O, and the degree to which Al was replaced by Si increased.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The stretching peak vibration of Si-O-Si in the silicon–oxygen tetrahedron oligomer was 778 cm−1, 460 cm−1 belonged to Al-O-Al stretching vibration, and the peak of BFA-A and BFA-N were enhanced here, indicating that there was silica–aluminate rearrangement during the aging process [39].

source_units.text: Combined with the analysis results of XRD, the aging process was conducive to the formation of amorphous geopolymers in BFA-N and BFA-A [40].

source_units.text:
Influence on Cd Immobilization Mechanism Induced by the Aging of BFA

Cd could be detected in BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A after the Cd adsorption experiment (Figure 11a).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: As shown in Figure 11b, compared with BFA, both BFA-N and BFA-A showed Ca loss, BFA-A was more obvious than BFA-N, and BFA-A increased Al loss more than BFA-N.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The Si ratio in BFA-N and BFA-A increased, there was no introduction of exogenous Si, but because of the loss of Ca and Al, the Si ratio was relatively increased, and the increase was more obvious in BFA-A.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The ratios of Fe and Mg were little different.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: According to the SEMs of each element in BFA particles (Figure S1) before aging and BFA-N particles (Figure 12 and Figure S2) after aging, the image distribution of Ca was the most consistent with Cd among the major elements, Si, Al, Mg, Ca, and Fe.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, it could be concluded that for BFA and BFA-N, the main mechanism of Cd immobilization was related to Ca, and there was no significant change.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Similarly, Maria [47] tested and analyzed the aged biochar by synchrotron radiation XAFS, and found that the main mechanism of Cd immobilization was the same as that before aging, which was still CdCO3 formation.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, in the SEM of BFA-A, none of the distribution images of all elements, including Ca, were consistent with Cd (Figure 13 and Figure S3).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Combined with the aforementioned physical and chemical properties of BFA-A, the O-C-O bond of CO32− in the FTIR spectrum was significantly destroyed and the pH decreased.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: These lead to Ca loss and the adsorption capacity of BFA-A to Cd reducing obviously.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Among BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A, the Ca content levels in Figure 11b were consistent with the Cd adsorption levels, which were shown by qe in Table 1, obtained by pseudo-second-order kinetic equation fitting, and Qm in Table 2, obtained by Langmuir equation fitting.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It could be inferred that the main Cd immobilization mechanism of BFA before and after aging was consistent, and was closely related to Ca, and it might be the adsorption and precipitation of Cd on the surface of oxides, hydroxides, and salts of Ca.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, the specific mechanism between Cd and Ca still needed to be further explored by other means, such as synchrotron radiation XAFS.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In addition, the Cd immobilization mechanism of BFA was found to include ion exchange, precipitation, complexation [48], obligate adsorption [49], isomorphous replacement, and others in prior studies [20].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Compared with BFA, the change of Cd immobilization mechanism of BFA-N and BFA-A after aging included: (1) the change in Zeta potential, which showed that the electrostatic adsorption of BFA-N strengthened, and the electrostatic adsorption of BFA-A weakened.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: (2) The amorphous state of the geopolymers in BFA-N and BFA-A could both enhance ion exchange adsorption [50,51].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: (3) The change in FTIR showed that the hydroxyl complexation of BFA-N was weakened, while the hydroxyl complexation of BFA-A was enhanced.

source_units.text:
Conclusions

Biofuel ash (BFA) was naturally aged into BFA-Natural aging (BFA-N) in the soil environment of southern China, and to simulate BFA-N, BFA was also artificially acid aged into BFA-Acid aging (BFA-A).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The results indicated that there were similarities and differences in physicochemical properties between BFA-N and BFA-A, that is, the artificial acid aging method could partially simulate natural aging.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The adsorption processes of BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A were more consistent with the pseudo-second-order kinetic model compared with the pseudo-first-order kinetic model, which indicated that the adsorption processes were mainly controlled by chemical action rather than by physical transport.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Both Langmuir and Freundlich equations fit the isothermal adsorption processes well.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: According to Qm in Langmuir equation and qe in the pseudo-second-order kinetic model, the Cd adsorption capacity of BFA reduced after natural aging, and the decrease was more obvious in BFA-A.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The immobilization of Cd included adsorption and precipitation, and adsorption was the dominant factor; the precipitation proportion was only 12.3%, 18.8%, and 1.7% of BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A, respectively.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Compared with BFA, both BFA-N and BFA-A showed Ca loss, BFA-A was more obvious than BFA-N.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The Ca content level was consistent with Cd adsorption level among BFA, BFA-N, and BFA-A. It could be inferred that the main immobilization mechanism of Cd by BFA before and after aging was consistent with and closely related to Ca.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It might be the adsorption and precipitation of Cd on the surface of oxides, hydroxides, and salts of Ca which still need to be explored further.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, the adsorption mechanism of electrostatic interaction, ion exchange, and hydroxyl complexation changed to varying degrees in BFA-N and BFA-A.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required
